title: 第692章 崩溃的神主第691章 盖世功德
lines: 第692章崩溃的神主
人间一片平静。
除了飞仙星古琴城的白家庄那里依然被大片符文所覆盖，引起了一些人的关注之外，没有任何其他波澜生出。
回到家中的子衿和问君这群人全都神情哀伤且异常沉默。
把家里这群人给吓了一跳，还以为小白出了什么意外。
结果一问才知道是杜老祖和姜无涯为了给众人打穿一条路牺牲了自己。
众人松了口气的同时，心中也都涌起一阵强烈的伤感。
这种牺牲非常伟大，但没有人愿意这种牺牲发生在自己身边。
“为什么这世上的生灵就不能和平相处呢？”司音红着眼睛，轻声叹息。
大萝莉也不再是当年那个懵懂的小丫头了。
“和平相处？想多了，妹子，做好大决战的准备吧！”单谷叹息一声，喃喃说道：“我现在只希望一件事……”
众人看向他。
“我只希望这群域外天魔，是我们最后一波敌人。”单谷叹息着说道：“我有些累了。”
“他已经开始了，他会成功的，一定会。”林子衿一脸认真的道。
无尽苍穹中的小白也很累。
超级疲惫！
当年他重建六道轮回的模型就已经很吃力。
如今这不是模型，是真正的六道轮回！
他要为整个人间众生，建设一条可以循环往复的路！
要让那些早迷失的灵魂，通过不断轮回，洗去杂质，最终成为高等级的生命体。
虚空中的负能量场域燃烧起来，帮了他很大的忙。
所以说起来，还真得感谢那些域外天魔。
他们都是好魔。
没有这力量，小白只会更加辛苦。
如果有人可以看见，一定会被这无比壮观的景象所震撼。
浩瀚的苍穹中，一条条符文形成的通路，充斥着不可思议的轮回物质，纵横长空！
像是一张无形的网，全部在白牧野的掌控之中，在无穷的宇宙中延伸出去，奔向一个又一个有生灵的地方！
同时，就在这片负能量涌动的区域，一座巨大无匹、如同神殿一样的建筑，开始缓缓形成，并且越来越大！
这是……地府！
重建六道，最重要的一个环节，自然就是地府的凝聚！
充斥着这片宇宙虚空的负能量翻涌着，不断转换成地府的阴气。
那群域外天魔作为幕后大黑手，用无尽岁月去布局，想要夺取重建六道轮回这份泼天功德。
可谁敢相信，到头来却依然是给别人做了嫁衣裳。
尽管身体和精神同时传来无尽的疲惫，但白牧野此刻还是有一种动力十足的感觉。
只要六道轮回成功重建，这人间……就算是彻底稳下来了。
到那时，他，和身边的所有人，也就可以好好休息一下了。
不用再疲于奔命。
多好！

Chapter 692 The Collapse of the God Lord
There was peace in the world.
Except for the Baijiazhuang in Feixianxing Guqin City, which was still covered by large runes, which attracted some people's attention, no other waves occurred.
When Zijin and Wenjun returned home, they all looked sad and unusually silent.
This group of people at home were shocked, thinking that something had happened to Xiaobai.
After asking, I found out that it was Du Laozu and Jiang Wuya who sacrificed themselves in order to clear a way for everyone.
While everyone breathed a sigh of relief, a strong sadness also surged in their hearts.
This kind of sacrifice is great, but no one wants this kind of sacrifice to happen to them.
"Why can't all creatures in this world live in peace?" Si Yin sighed softly with red eyes.
The big Lolita is no longer the ignorant little girl she used to be.
"Live in peace? You're thinking too much, sister, get ready for the decisive battle!" Shan Gu sighed and murmured: "I only hope for one thing now..."
Everyone looked at him.
"I just hope that these extraterrestrial demons will be our last wave of enemies." Shan Gu sighed and said, "I'm a little tired."
"He has already started. He will succeed. He will definitely." Lin Zijin said seriously.
Xiaobai in the endless sky is also very tired.
Super tired!
It was already very difficult for him to reconstruct the model of the Six Paths of Reincarnation back then.
Now this is not a model, it is the real six paths of reincarnation!
He wants to build a cyclical road for all sentient beings in the world!
It is necessary to allow those souls that have been lost long ago to wash away impurities through continuous reincarnation and eventually become high-level life forms.
The negative energy field in the void burned up, which helped him a lot.
So speaking of it, I really have to thank those extraterrestrial demons.
They are both good demons.
Without this power, Xiaobai would only work harder.
If anyone could see it, they would be shocked by this extremely spectacular sight.
In the vast sky, paths formed by runes are filled with incredible reincarnation matter, stretching across the sky!
It's like an invisible net, all under Bai Muye's control, extending out in the infinite universe, rushing to one place after another with life!
At the same time, in this area where negative energy surged, a huge, temple-like building began to slowly take shape, and it got bigger and bigger!
This is... underworld!
The most important link in rebuilding the Six Paths is naturally the cohesion of the underworld!
The negative energy that fills the void of the universe is surging, constantly transforming into the Yin Qi of the underworld.
The group of extraterrestrial demons, as the masterminds behind the scenes, spent endless years planning to seize the great merit of rebuilding the Six Paths of Reincarnation.
But who dares to believe that in the end, she still made wedding clothes for others.
Despite endless exhaustion both physically and mentally, Bai Muye still felt motivated at the moment.
As long as the six paths of reincarnation are successfully reestablished, this world... will be completely stabilized.
By then, he, and everyone around him, could have a good rest.
No more struggling to make ends meet.
How nice!
